title: Yet Another Unnecessary Modpack
description: A large-ish modpack focused entirely on exploration and building based on 1.21.10 Fabric.
body:
This is Yet Another Unnecessary Modpack! A medium-sized modpack that adds a ton of new content based on 1.21.10 :3

This modpack has official VR support with the help of ViveCraft! (Please note: this requires a BEEFY PC, especially if you would like to play with Shaders!) The VR support does work on Arch Linux (idk about other Distros), however, you need to set up ALVR for Quest headsets to work. Search up "how to set up ALVR" and it will explain it as I don't think I can place links here. Obviously, there is no issues with Windows, however, I would recommend using Virtual Desktop instead of SteamVR, but that's your choice, it'll work either way.

This modpack has been tested on Windows 10/11, and Arch Linux (KDE Plasma). It hasn't been tested on anything else so I cannot ensure compatibility on other Operating Systems.

------------------------------------------------------------------
                         Specs List
------------------------------------------------------------------

> Absolute Minimum Specs: (you won't get good FPS with these!)
    > CPU: Ryzen 3 3000+ / Intel i3 7th Gen
    > RAM: 4GB Allocated (at least 8GB full system memory / DDR4)
    > GPU (w/o Shaders): iGPU (Ryzen 3 3000 / Intel i3 7th Gen)
    > GPU (w/ Shaders): iGPU (Ryzen 5 5000 / Intel i3 10th Gen)
    > Storage: At least 1GB of Storage on a Hard Drive (HDD)

> Recommended Specs:
    > CPU: Ryzen 5 5600G / Intel i7 10th Gen
    > RAM: 6GB Allocated (at least 12GB full system memory / DDR4)
    > GPU (w/o Shaders): GTX 1050 Ti / Radeon RX 6000
    > GPU (w/ Shaders): GTX 1080 Ti / Radeon RX 7000
    > Storage: At least 1GB of Storage on a Solid State Drive (SSD)

Obviously, these will change depeneding on the mods you add, the resource packs you add, the shader packs you add but these were based on:

> Render Distance: 12
> Shadow Distance: 32
> Simulation Distance: 12
> Solas Shader at High Settings
> Fancy Graphics

------------------------------------------------------------------
                        Specs List (VR)
------------------------------------------------------------------

> Absolute Minimum Specs: (you won't get good FPS with these!)
    > CPU: Ryzen 5 5600 / Intel Core i5 10th Gen
    > RAM: 6GB Allocated (at least 12GB full system memory / DDR4)
    > GPU (w/o Shaders): NVIDIA GTX 1080 Ti / Radeon RX 6000
    > GPU (w/ Shaders): NVIDIA RTX 2070 / Radeon RX 7000
    > Storage: At least 1GB of Storage on a Hard Disk Drive (HDD)

> Recommended Specs:
    > CPU: Ryzen 7 5700 / Intel Core i5 11th Gen
    > RAM: 8GB Allocated (at least 16GB fully system memory / DDR4)
    > GPU (w/o Shaders): NVIDIA RTX 2070S / Radeon RX 6000
    > GPU (w/ Shaders): NVIDIA RTX 3080 / Radeon RX 7900
    > Storage: At least 1GB of Storage on a Solid State Drive (SSD)

------------------------------------------------------------------
                                 Mods
------------------------------------------------------------------
                                 
Shaders and RP:
- Solas Shader
- BSL Shaders
- Complementary Shaders
- Fresh Animations Resource Pack

---------------------------------

UI, Visual and Optimisation:

This modpack includes both Sodium and Iris so you can play with your favorite shaderpacks (or you can use the included shaders!) as well as:
- Lithium (for any servers)
- Entity Culling (hides the things you can't see)
- Immediately Fast (just speeds up the game)
- Sodium Extra (gives you more Sodium options)
- Reece's Sodium Options (even more Sodium options)
- Dynamic FPS (reduces FPS when AFK)
- Not Enough Crashes (tells you what happened if the game crashes)
- Entity Model Features (allows OptiFine models to be used)
- Entity Texture Features (allows OptiFine textures to be used)
- Entity Sound Features (allows OptiFine sounds to be used)
- 3D Skin Layers (renders players in 3D)
- Not Enough Animations (shows 1st-person animations in 3rd-person)
- AppleSkin (gives food information)
- Jade (tells you which block or entity you are looking at and gives info on it)
- Sound Physics Remastered (makes sound effects more realistic)
- Chat Heads (shows who you are talking to in the chat)
- Enchantment Descriptions (gives you information on an Enchantment)
- Essential (allows you to play with friends and adds Skin Customisation)
- Presence Footsteps (gives each block a new walking sound)
- Visuality (adds more particle effects)
- Ambient Sounds (adds more sound effects to make the outside seem more realistic)
- Distant Horizons (lets you play with VERY high render distances)
- Visual Workbench (lets items stay in the crafting interface and shows them on top)
- Better Advancements (overhauls the advancements screen)
- Dynamic Crosshair (changes the crosshair depending on what you're looking at)
- Physics Mod (makes blocks and items act more realistically)
- Durability Tooltip (shows you the durability of a weapon or tool)
- Enhanced Visuals (enhances the visuals of the game)
- Spawn Animations (gives mobs a little more personality ;3 )
- Monsters In The Closet (shows you what mobs aren't letting you sleep)
- Female Gender Mod (uhh... hmm)
- Trash Slot (lets you delete items from existance)
- Totem Counter (counts how many times you've revived yourself)
- Axolotl Buckets (shows the correct axolotl type in your inventory)
- Advancement Screenshot (takes a screenshot when you get an Advancement)
- Completionist's Index (shows you every block and whether you've collected it)
- Cake Chomps (plays a sound and spawns particles when you eat cake)
- Paper Doll (shows your player model on screen (similar to Bedrock Edition))
- Borderless Fullscreen (lets you play in Borderless Fullscreen mode)
- Xaeros's Minimap (puts a minimap on-screen)
- Xaero's WorldMap (shows you the whole world and lets you have waypoints)
- Replay Mod (lets you create clips and timelapses)
- Mod Menu (shows you every mod installed as well as configurate them)
- Overflowing Bars (makes the UI easier to read)
- Animated Mojang Logo (animates the MoJang Logo)
- Craftable Notch Apple (makes the Enchanted Golden Apple craftable)
- Dynamic Lights (adds lights that move with your character)

---------------------------------

What if you wanna explore and fight? Well...
- Nature's Compass (gives you a compass to locate any biome)
- Traveler's Backpack (lets you have backpacks to store anything)
- Biomes O' Plenty (adds TONS of new blocks and biomes to explore)
- Waystones (allows you to create waypoints (similar to Xaero's WorldMap))
- Comforts (lets you create sleeping bags and hammocks)
- Dungeons and Taverns (adds a lot of dungeons to explore)
- Lootr (allows each player to get loot instead of just one)
- Towns and Towers (adds towns and towers for you to explore)
- Villager Names (gives each villager you meet a custom name)
- Do A Barrel Roll (move with elytras in style)
- Friends&Foes (adds a lot of the mobs that were scrapped)
    - Beekeeper Hut (adds a beekeeper and hut to Friends&Foes)
    - Flowery Mooblooms (adds Flowery Mooblooms to Friends&Foes)
- Voice Chat Interaction (adds Voice Chat to the game)
- Advanced Netherite (creates a lot of customisable Netherite Armor and Tools)
- Falling Tree (makes trees fall down instead of floating)
- Explorer's Compass (adds a compass that locates any structure)
- Repurposed Structures (adds a lot of variants of structures)
- Trading Post (lets you trade with all villagers at once)
- Double Doors (opens both doors at once)
- Moog's End Structures (adds more structures to the End Dimension)
    - Voyager Structures (adds more structures to the seas)
    - Nether Structures (adds more structures to the Nether Dimension)
    - Soaring Structures (adds structures to the sky)
- Explorify (adds Vanilla+ style structures)
- Illager Invasion (port of Illager Expansion that adds more Illager stuff)
- Veinminer (lets you mine an entire vein of ores at once)
    - Veinminer Enchantment (makes this an enchantment instead)
- Sit (lets you sit on slabs and stairs)
- Serene Seasons (lets the seasons change instead of it being one season)
- Formations Nether (adds more structures to the Nether)
- Formations Overworkd (adds more structures to the Overworld)
- Promenade (CAPYBARAS)
- Universal Ores (adds ores for each stone type)
- Underground Worlds (adds underground biomes and dungeons)
- Grind Enchantments (lets you grind enchantments onto a book)
- Abridged (generates bridges randomly)
- Just Hammers (lets you make hammers to destroy with)
- Respawnable Pets (gives you one last chance to save your pets)
- Enderite Mod (a new material to make armor out of)
- More Music Discs (expands the amount of music discs in the game)
- Hang Glider (adds a hang glider)
- Tough As Nails (makes the game 10x harder with Thirst and Temperature)
- Guns++ (adds some overpowered guns to the game)
- Spikey Spikes (lets you protect your home with spikes)
- Areas (shows you the area in which you are in)
- Variants & Ventures (gives the mobs more variants)
- Snuffles (adds cute little mobs to the icy biomes)
- Gravestones (keeps all your items safe when you die)
- Dis-Enchanting Table (lets you remove enchantments from armor and tools)
- Living Things (adds more animals into the game)
- Giant Spawn (allows giants to spawn naturally)
- Chococraft (adds a new mob)
- Crab Claws (adds a new item that lets you reach REALLY far)
- Mutants and Zombies (adds more zombie variants)
- Happy Pride Moth (MOTHS)
- More Enchants (adds a new Enchantments to add to your tools, weapons and armor)

---------------------------------

Like food and building?
- Farmer's Delight Refabricated (adds a lot of new food items)
- Farmer's Cutting: Biomes O' Plenty (Biomes O' Plenty compat mod)
- Diagonal Fences (lets fences connect diagonally)
- Diagonal Windows (lets windows connect diagonally)
- Diagonal Walls (lets walls connect diagonally)
- Macaw's Mods (all add new building blocks and items)
    - Fences and Walls
    - Windows
    - Bridges
    - Doors
    - Roofs
    - Stairs
    - Furniture
    - Paths and Pavings
    - Trapdoors
    - Lights and Lamps
    - Holidays
    - Biomes O' Plenty Compat
- Stoneworks (adds a lot of new stone variants)
- Animal Feeding Trough (no longer need to feed animals, they'll do it)
- Kleeslabs (only breaks the slab you are looking at)
- Connectable Chains (lets you connect chains to fences)
- Enchanted Vertical Slabs (adds vertical slabs)
- Storage Drawers (adds more storage options)
- Storage Delight (Compat between Storage Drawers and Farmer's Delight)
- Reinforced Barrels (barrels. but better! Adds more barrels)
- Display Case (display your most prized possessions)
- Night Lights (gives you cute little frog lights)
- Mo' Glass (adds glass variants, like stairs and slabs)
- Blåhaj of Undying (adds adorable Blåhaj plushies :3)
- Hot Kettles (adds kettles and drinks (bri´ish simula'a))
